title: Distance to bank as IV for savings rate
research_question: Does having a bank account increase household savings, using distance to the nearest bank branch as an instrument for account ownership?
data_description: Cross-sectional data on 500 households. Variables: y (monthly savings in USD), x (has_account binary), z (distance to nearest branch in km — instrument), controls (income, education). First stage: distance → account ownership (negative). Exclusion: distance affects savings only through account ownership.
